name: Norvelian Capital

leadership.name: Arjun Mehra
leadership.summary: Leads investment strategy, capital allocation and investment decision-making across the real estate portfolio.
leadership.bio: Arjun approaches property investment through the relationship between purchase price, sustainable cash flows and the risks of ownership. His early work in investment analysis developed into a broader focus on portfolio strategy and capital allocation. He co-founded Norvelian in 2019 to establish a disciplined approach to real estate ownership, grounded in valuation and long-term asset fundamentals. As CIO, he leads investment thesis development, acquisition screening and investment committee deliberations, working with the finance, research and risk teams to challenge assumptions before capital is committed. He also reviews exit alternatives and the continuing relevance of each investment thesis.
education: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) — University of Delhi
MBA — MIT Sloan School of Management

career.title: Real estate underwriting and portfolio strategy
Managing Partner & Chief Investment Officer — Norvelian Capital

leadership.sectors: Office; logistics; industrial; retail; income-producing mixed-use assets

leadership.name: Nandita Rao
leadership.summary: Leads acquisition underwriting, commercial diligence and transaction execution.
leadership.bio: Nandita concentrates on converting a potential acquisition into an evidence-based investment decision. She examines the quality of rental income, lease obligations, operating costs, capital expenditure and location fundamentals before recommending transaction terms. Her career began in acquisitions underwriting and developed towards coordinating financial, legal and technical reviews. As a co-founder of Norvelian, she leads the acquisition process from initial screening through negotiation and closing readiness. Her team works with external advisers where specialist legal or technical opinions are needed. She distinguishes between risks that can be priced, risks that require contractual protection and risks that justify declining an opportunity.
education: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) — University of Mumbai
MBA — Indian Institute of Management Calcutta

career.title: Founding Partner & Head of Acquisitions — Norvelian Capital

leadership.sectors: Commercial offices; industrial and logistics; retail; mixed-use properties

leadership.name: Dev Malpani
leadership.summary: Oversees operations as Chief Operating Officer, drawing on his background in technical due diligence, development feasibility and construction risk.
leadership.bio: Dev focuses on the physical and delivery characteristics that can alter a property investment thesis. His engineering and construction management background developed towards project controls, technical assessment and redevelopment planning. As Chief Operating Officer at Norvelian, Dev oversees operational coordination, bringing his technical background to the assessment of building condition, development potential and capital works. For existing assets, he evaluates redevelopment alternatives and major capital projects alongside asset management and finance. His technical experience informs operational decisions involving cost, scheduling and project risk.
education: Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech.) in Civil Engineering — Indian Institute of Technology Delhi
Master of Technology (M.Tech.) in Construction Engineering and Management — Indian Institute of Technology Delhi
leadership.sectors: Commercial buildings; industrial facilities; logistics; redevelopment projects

leadership.name: Siddharth Bansal
leadership.role: Chief Financial Officer — Finance & Capital Markets
leadership.summary: Leads financial management, treasury, financing strategy and capital structure analysis.
leadership.bio: Siddharth connects the economics of real estate assets with the financing obligations of their owners. His background in accounting and corporate finance evolved towards property financing, liquidity management and capital structure assessment. At Norvelian, he oversees financial planning, treasury and reporting processes, evaluates debt and equity alternatives and monitors refinancing exposure. He works with acquisitions and portfolio management to assess financing costs, debt service capacity and covenant headroom. His approach prioritises sustainable funding arrangements, reliable financial information and sufficient liquidity across market cycles. He also holds an MBA from New York University (NYU) and a PhD in Finance from Boston University.
education: Bachelor of Commerce (Honours) — University of Delhi
Chartered Accountancy (CA), professional qualification — Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI)
Master of Business Administration (MBA) — New York University (NYU)
Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Finance — Boston University

career.title: Accounting, financial reporting and financial analysis
Real estate financing and treasury strategy
Chief Financial Officer — Finance & Capital Markets — Norvelian Capital

leadership.sectors: Commercial real estate; income-producing property; property holding structures

leadership.name: Tara Khanna
leadership.summary: Develops strategic relationships and evaluates potential commercial and investment collaborations.
leadership.bio: Tara approaches partnerships as long-term arrangements requiring alignment of objectives, incentives and responsibilities. Her background in real estate business development and stakeholder coordination evolved towards the assessment of joint venture opportunities and institutional relationships. At Norvelian, she leads early partnership discussions, evaluates strategic fit and coordinates internal review with investment, finance and governance teams. She focuses on understanding partner capabilities, decision rights and commercial expectations before a proposal progresses. Her remit is partnership development, not an independent authority to approve investments or solicit regulated investment products.
education: Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) in Economics — University of Mumbai
Master of Management Studies (MMS) — K. J. Somaiya Institute of Management, Mumbai
leadership.sectors: Commercial real estate; developers; property operators; institutional counterparties

leadership.name: Rohan Kapoor
leadership.summary: Translates investment objectives into asset business plans, operating priorities and property performance reviews.
leadership.bio: Rohan views asset management as the active stewardship of a property after acquisition. His engineering background and experience in commercial property operations inform his assessment of building condition, operating costs and capital works. He joined Norvelian in 2020 to lead asset-level business planning, working with property operators and leasing specialists to improve income durability and long-term asset relevance. He reviews annual budgets, capital expenditure priorities and performance against underwriting assumptions. His work distinguishes ongoing maintenance from strategic investment in a property, and considers how operational decisions influence net operating income and asset value.
education: Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech.) in Civil Engineering — Manipal Institute of Technology, Manipal
leadership.sectors: Office; industrial; logistics; commercial mixed-use properties

leadership.name: Shreya Iyer
leadership.summary: Oversees portfolio construction, performance analysis and alignment of asset-level decisions with portfolio objectives.
leadership.bio: Shreya examines how individual properties collectively contribute to the performance and resilience of a portfolio. Her background in investment reporting developed towards portfolio analysis and allocation review. At Norvelian, she monitors exposure by asset class, geography, tenant and lease maturity, and evaluates how acquisitions, disposals and capital expenditure affect portfolio objectives. She coordinates periodic performance reviews and separates operating performance from market-driven valuation changes. Working with the CIO and risk director, she assesses concentration and diversification trade-offs without treating property-level returns as independent of broader portfolio conditions.
education: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) — University of Madras
Postgraduate Diploma in Management (PGDM), finance focus — Loyola Institute of Business Administration, Chennai
leadership.sectors: Multi-asset commercial property portfolios; office; retail; industrial and logistics

leadership.name: Kabir Sethi
leadership.summary: Leads leasing strategy, tenant positioning and sustainable rental income planning.
leadership.bio: Kabir studies the relationship between occupier demand and the income potential of commercial property. His background in office leasing and occupier advisory developed into a focus on tenant retention, lease structures and asset positioning. At Norvelian, he works with asset management to define leasing priorities, assess market rental levels and evaluate the economic implications of incentives, vacancy periods and renewals. He considers tenant requirements alongside lease expiry concentration and tenant credit considerations, balancing near-term occupancy with long-term income resilience.
education: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) — Savitribai Phule Pune University (formerly University of Pune)
Postgraduate Diploma in Management (PGDM), marketing focus — Institute of Management Technology, Nagpur

career.title: Leasing strategy and commercial asset positioning
Director — Leasing & Occupier Strategy — Norvelian Capital

leadership.name: Priya Narayanan
leadership.summary: Leads independent investment risk analysis, quantitative modelling and portfolio stress testing.
leadership.bio: Priya brings statistical reasoning to decisions involving uncertain cash flows, changing market conditions and incomplete property data. Her professional background developed from quantitative analysis into financial risk modelling and investment scenario assessment. At Norvelian, she challenges underwriting assumptions, assesses portfolio exposures and develops stress tests for rental declines, vacancy, interest rate changes and refinancing pressures. Her remit is distinct from investment origination: she provides independent analytical review and escalates material risks through the proposed governance framework. She emphasises model limitations, data quality and the need to interpret statistical results in the context of illiquid real estate markets.
education: Bachelor of Statistics (Honours) — Indian Statistical Institute
Master of Statistics (M.Stat.) — Indian Statistical Institute

career.title: Director — Investment Risk & Analytics — Norvelian Capital

leadership.sectors: Commercial property portfolios; income-producing assets; real estate debt exposures

leadership.name: Vikram Shah
leadership.summary: Focuses on operating governance, internal controls and coordination across investment and asset-management functions.
leadership.bio: Vikram focuses on the institutional processes that make investment decisions accountable and repeatable. Beginning in investment operations, he developed an interest in decision records, reporting workflows and operational controls. As a director at Norvelian, he contributes to operating governance, internal controls and the coordination of responsibilities across the asset lifecycle. His remit includes vendor governance, process design, information management and coordination with finance and risk specialists. He works to separate investment recommendations, approvals and execution responsibilities so that operational efficiency does not come at the expense of oversight.
education: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) — Gujarat University
Master of Business Administration (MBA), operations focus — Institute of Management, Nirma University
leadership.sectors: Investment operations; commercial property ownership; multi-asset portfolios

leadership.name: Ananya Menon
leadership.summary: Produces market intelligence and economic analysis to support investment screening and portfolio decisions.
leadership.bio: Ananya studies the economic and spatial forces that shape property demand. Her background in economics and property-market research informs her analysis of employment growth, business activity, infrastructure connectivity and development supply. At Norvelian, she leads research assignments supporting acquisition screening and periodic portfolio review. She develops market briefs, comparative location assessments and demand scenarios, making data sources and methodological limitations explicit. Her work connects macroeconomic conditions with local property-market fundamentals, while avoiding the assumption that aggregate growth automatically translates into demand for a particular asset.
education: Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) in Economics — University of Delhi
Master of Arts (M.A.) in Economics — University of Hyderabad
